messages:
jess: Heads-up: samplekit toolcall tests failing on Node because of stray whitespace in function args -> schema rejects. Repro in starter-app's onboarding flow. Minimal repro below.

jess: ```json
{
  "action": "create_user",
  "params": {
    "email": "  user@example.com ",
    "name": "Dana"
  }
}
```

mike: Hmm, thanks. Can you paste the validator error from the Node run?

jess: ```
Error: SchemaValidationError: value for params.email did not match 'email' format
  at validate (/repo/node_modules/schema/lib/validate.js:45:17)
  at ToolRunner._run (/repo/lib/toolrunner.js:210:12)
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```

samir: Oh — looks like Node SDK isn't trimming input strings before schema validation. Python SDK auto-normalizes strings in ToolRequest. That's a parity bug.

mike: Does this happen before auth/retry? Could a retry be re-floating the raw whitespace?

jess: It's happening before auth. CI log shows validation fails at parse time, so auth/retry never kicks in. devex-bot: <ci/redwood/samplekit#842> failed on branch `onboard-fix` :x:

samir: Proposed quick fix: add optional `normalizeInputs: { trimStrings: true }` to SDK ToolRequest constructor and call before schema validation. Make Node default to false for backwards compat, but enable true in starter-app's samplekit.

jess: If we default false, onboarding will still hit this. I'd prefer enabling true in SDK minor release and document breaking surface in changelog. Leaning to opt-in for now and enable in samplekit.

mike: Can we add a lightweight migration check in the console when someone's onboarding samplekit hits validation errors? Like a UX hint: "Try trimming whitespace" with a link to docs.

jess: Good idea. Also add unit tests for both `" email "` and `"\tuser@example.com\n"` cases.

samir: I'll open a PR with the helper and tests. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwoodinference/samplekit/pull/128 (WIP)

mike: :thumbsup: assign to @samir. After PR merge, update starter template and release notes.

jess: Thanks — saving the CI logs and I'll patch the onboarding guide. :rocket:

devex-bot: Created issue redwood/devex#519 for docs update.

jess: Closing loop — plan: PR -> samplekit patch -> enable normalize in samplekit -> docs update. ETA EOD tomorrow.
